semiconductor_relevance: High — Kanomax Holdings (Shanghai) Co., Ltd provides specialized measurement equipment critical for advanced semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Kanomax Holdings (Shanghai) Co., Ltd offers the STPC3, the industry's only real-time liquid particle counter for isopropyl alcohol (IPA), essential for ensuring the purity of chemicals used in semiconductor fabrication. Their technology helps top-tier fabrication facilities assess the readiness of IPA and other chemicals for wafer contact in advanced manufacturing processes.
capabilities: Real-time liquid particle counting for isopropyl alcohol
Nebulization and condensation particle counting technology
Measurement of particle concentrations at 3 nm, 9 nm, and 15 nm

regional_presence.China: The company operates in Shanghai, focusing on the semiconductor industry with advanced measurement solutions.
